project.name: MeshMedic
project.tagline: AI-powered clinical documentation and workflow copilot for healthcare professionals.

requirements.text: Process patient encounter conversations to generate structured clinical notes.
Suggest appropriate ICD-10 and CPT codes based on encounter data.
Identify potential gaps in care from encounter data.
Prepare follow-up documentation such as referral letters for clinician review.
Allow clinicians to review, edit, approve, or reject AI-generated notes, codes, and recommendations.
Maintain an auditable history of AI recommendations and clinician actions.
Provide clear explanations for its recommendations, including source citations.
Flag low-confidence sections with a visual warning and explanation.
Retrieve and return authorized patient information through EHR systems using FHIR APIs.
Remain EHR-agnostic while integrating with Epic and Oracle Health/Cerner.
Protect PHI and ensure privacy and security compliance.
Reduce documentation time to under 2 minutes of review per note.
Distinguish between encounter-supported and AI-generated information.
Not execute clinical decisions or actions without clinician approval.
Use ambient audio recordings and text transcripts as input for note generation.
Access patient demographics and problem list/history from EHRs.
Provide a visual interface for clinicians to interact with AI-generated content.
Support healthcare compliance standards relevant to clinical documentation.
